Name: Activate Sprinklers
Author: f4iThh
Description:
[i]Activate Sprinklers will let you activate sprinklers by simply right clicking them.[/i]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/ActivateSprinklers/docs/images/sample.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/ActivateSprinklers/docs/images/generic.png[/img]

Optionally, see [url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/ActivateSprinklers#configuration]README.md[/url].

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://github.com/lambui]PhthaloBlue[/url]﻿, for being the original developer of the mod.
